required_handoff: Complete frozen manifest and constituent hashes/read order
Final source citation/provenance locators if not carried by frozen packet
procedure: Read the complete frozen packet and derive document, task, help, label, asset and expression inventories; never inherit previous lesson counts or IDs.
Fetch each exact immutable raw constituent and actual GitHub page into unique paths; match frozen bytes, commit/path and complete richText identity.

Extract every source payload and actual math node type/order with one HTML parse; preserve literal entities as observed. Compare all operands/operators/grouping/spacing; document only syntactic delimiter-LF conventions.

Compare complete prose, paragraph-start labels, actual list semantics and all figure alt/path/order correspondence. Apply current strict protected-inline comparisons rule without altering literal HTML/code.

Derive every positive task→hint→solution/return route and all global file-entry paths; inspect actual immutable hrefs and sanitized names under current official GitHub contract. Do not pass an empty route set.
Fetch applicable CSS and audit actual node/selector typography. Hash all source/citation identities. View every fresh constituent figure in full, including any companions named by manifest.

Finish complete original audit if a failure appears, retain every exact instance and original bytes, report to root and hold costly preview until root disposes of the frozen revision. Never patch learner files.

If actual destination is preserved, adapt the established converter to actual document names, IDs and Markdown structures; copy these current frozen controls assets, combine all source material in manifest order and map every anchor/link/image with full canonical AST equality.

Use numbered exclusive attempt directories and exclusive binary/log writes. Capture failed attempts without rerunning into their stdout. Compile controlled full project; copy stable canonical PDF once and immediately verify complete bytes, EOF, page count and hash.

Render each canonical page from a fresh-open PDF before image-bearing text-dictionary extraction. Verify saved rasters pixel-exact in a separate fresh-open instance, with no in-memory read-order substitutions. View every full frame and record per-page findings.

Verify all native named destinations/annotations against complete source link order, target-label pages, file entries and returns; hints and complete solutions must occupy disjoint page sets. Inspect fonts and actual pages for forced emphasis, clipping and body/footer conflicts.
Write exact scoped report/final audit, preserve original diagnostics and create self-excluding evidence manifest last; tell root directory is stable. Root alone accepts, archives and publishes.

adaptation_requirements: No fixed previous filenames, counts, titles, q1..q6 assumptions or accepted-result constants
Attach an empty source anchor to its intended following content with leavevmode/hypertarget so it lands on the actual label page; use appropriate Needspace
Reverse presentation mappings to prove complete canonical source AST equals preview AST
Retain every original TeX payload exactly after delimiter conversion
Never use prior PASS or prior page views as current evidence

limits: Server parsed content/CSS is not client MathJax or live GitHub pixels/computed style/click evidence
Internal PDF preview is distinct from requested repository-native product, not an Overleaf test or user PDF delivery
No browser clicks inferred from named destinations; native contract and data only unless actually exercised
This is the designated destination reviewer, not a fresh SASIS reader; no extra agents or author work
ownership: Only current-r23/destination-preparation during preparation; wait for root freeze and concrete review directory before execution
next_action: Wait without polling for root immutable commit/manifest.
